name: dsh-codegraph
description: CodeGraph for DSH — registers 13 native `codegraph_*` tools (status/init/index/sync/uninit/query/node/explore/files/callers/callees/impact/affected) wrapping the `codegraph` CLI, so the DSH agent can bootstrap, maintain, and query a pre-indexed code knowledge graph without grepping files.

scripts.prepare: node -e "require('node:fs').accessSync('lib/index.js')" || echo 'dsh-codegraph: nothing to build — lib/index.js ships as source'
